name: opulent
description: Deterministic model routing: Opus (or optionally Fable) leads as architect and orchestrator; implementation and verification are delegated to pinned Opus and Sonnet contexts, and search goes to Claude Code's built-in Explore agent — while documentation and UI verification stay with the architect that made the design decisions. Implementation is a binary choice: xhigh by default, max only for a named hazard. A hook guards the control plane and records what the main loop does — routing steered and auditable, not walled off.
